verdict.rationale: Datadog's API reference lets users pick an official client library on each endpoint to see code examples. It also provides an official Postman collection for executing authenticated requests, so examples can be run, but only through an external tool. There is no evidence of in-page "try it" execution, and the OpenAPI probes at common doc paths returned 404. missing for 10: in-browser runnable/try-it console in the reference itself, evidence that examples are copy-run ready, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Select one of our official [client libraries](/extend/community/libraries/) languages in each endpoint to see code examples from that library.
To authenticate to the Datadog API through Postman, add your Datadog API and Application key values to the **Collection variables** of the Datadog API collection.
Use the Datadog API to access the Datadog platform programmatically.
